messages:
Anna P.: Quick note — QA hit a mismatch between the in-console docs panel and the main docs for the model routing flow. In docs we use 'fallback policy' but the console UI says 'degraded mode'. That feels confusing for customers.
Guillermo: Good catch. We should standardize. I don't have a strong preference, but 'fallback policy' reads clearer to me. @Melissa (Docs) can you confirm canonical term?
Melissa (Docs): Yep, canonical in the public docs is 'fallback policy'. I updated some microcopy in the console PR yesterday and accidentally used 'degraded mode' there. My bad.
Melissa (Docs): Also noticed the in-product panel links don't deep-link to the right anchor — e.g. console opens to the top of the doc instead of jumping to the 'caching and routing' section. Example: console links: `/console/models#routing` vs docs anchor: `#fallback-policy-behavior`
Guillermo: Ugh. Can you paste the exact link the console is generating? We should make the console produce the docs URL rather than its own fragment.
Melissa (Docs): Current console output (from PR):
```
https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/models#routing
```
The correct deep link to the canonical section is: `https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/models#fallback-policy-behavior`
Guillermo: Thanks. I'll change the link template to use the docs canonical slug mapping. I'll also change the UI copy to 'Fallback policy' to match docs. Small patch.
Sam K.: Accessibility note: when the in-product docs panel opens it doesn't move keyboard focus into the panel (focus remains on the Help button). Screen reader users can't tab into the content unless they manually focus. Filed internal issue: https://redwood-internal/issue/3421
Anna P.: Good catch, @Sam K. We should do a small accessibility pass at the same time as copy/link updates. Focus trap + visible focus state on the close button.
Melissa (Docs): I'll add an aria-live note for when deep-links land — so if someone arrives via a link we announce the section. Also will add a small inline sentence suggesting 'For routing policies see the fallback policy section' to make the cross-linking explicit.
docs-bot: Added docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 and linked issue #428 in repo.
Guillermo: Plan: 1) change console template to use canonical doc slugs (small one-line code change) 2) update console microcopy to 'Fallback policy' 3) coordinate with docs PR for anchors + aria text 4) close accessibility issue with small focus fix. I'll do (1)+(2) today, tag @Melissa for (3).
Anna P.: Sounds good. Can we also add a tiny E2E that verifies console link -> docs anchor resolves (just a 1-liner check)? Saves us from regressions.
Guillermo: Yep. I'll add a playwright check that navigates to the generated docs URL and asserts the hash-target heading exists.
Sam K.: After fix, can QA verify NVDA/VoiceOver that focus is inside the panel when opened via keyboard and when opened via deep-link?
Anna P.: Assigning: @Guillermo (console PR + e2e), @Melissa (docs anchor + aria text), @Sam K. (QA accessibility verification). ETA EOD for console changes, docs PR early tomorrow.
Melissa (Docs): I'll include the updated anchor and a short crosslink sentence. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
Guillermo: Patch opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/983 — includes copy change + link template + e2e test.
Anna P.: Awesome. Let's recheck in the morning if QA flags anything. Thanks all.
